put.description: Updates ICCID status. For used status, records replacement metadata and requires replaced_by_iccid to already exist in iccid_master. For available status, replacement metadata is cleared and returned as null.

parameters.name: iccid
parameters.description: ICCID to update (alphanumeric, no special characters)

422.description: Validation error (invalid payload, ICCID already has replacement data, or replaced_by_iccid not found)

post.summary: Upload ICCID master CSV for bulk update

post.summary: Upload ICCID master CSV for bulk delete
post.description: Upload a CSV file listing ICCIDs to delete. Records with replacement data cannot be deleted. Processing runs asynchronously. Roles: configuser, factoryadmin.
